_comment: Ratchet for `pnpm lint:design` (docs/design/silver-lining.md section 13). Each entry is the number of raw-colour / off-scale-font violations tolerated in that file. Counts may only go down: the gate fails if a file exceeds its count AND if it drops below (lower the entry in the same change). New files get no allowance. Tracking: migrate text-[10px]/[9px] to the 11px floor and text-lg/xl/4xl/5xl to the type scale as screens are restyled (ui/core-overhaul).
